description:
Two storey rear extension, extending existing roof to create larger crown roof, forming one rear box dormer. Single storey rear extension
spanning whole rear width with installation of two roof lanterns. New single storey side extension with installation of two lanterns. Replacement front door, new windows to side elevation and a basement extension.
